item.title: GTA 6 Obliterates All-Time Streaming Record Before It's Even Fully Released
item.description:
Across Twitch, YouTube, and more.

You'd better get used to seeing GTA 6 break records, because the game's not even out yet in most countries and it's already crushing long-standing numbers.

Indeed, the hype is so colossal that Rockstar's open worlder broke the all-time record for livestream viewers just minutes after its release in regions where it's already the 19th November.

Read the full article on pushsquare.com

item.title: Round Up: GTA 6 Is Not Just the Most Acclaimed Game of 2026, It's the Highest-Rated Game of All Time
item.description:
The reviews are in.

The initial reviews have arrived for GTA 6, and it's safe to say the game has been an absolute smash hit with critics.

The metascore has settled on a 99, making it one point off a "perfect" score of 100. In a year stuffed with fantastic games big and small, it's become the highest rated title of 2026.

Read the full article on pushsquare.com

item.title: NBA Players Receive This Special GTA 6 PS5 Pro Console, and We're Not Jealous at All
item.description:
Not one bit.

On the eve of GTA 6 finally making its debut, it seems a lucky few have been given a special way to play it.

Several NBA players, all belonging to the Miami Heat team, have received a crazy care package from Rockstar Games that includes a special edition PS5 Pro console that's not publicly available.

Read the full article on pushsquare.com
